note: Curated pan-India government schemes, marketplaces and input resources for farmers. Verify eligibility and current details on the official portal before applying.

resources.name: PM-KISAN
resources.description: ₹6,000/year direct income support to landholding farmer families in three installments.

resources.name: Soil Health Card
resources.description: Free soil testing with crop-wise nutrient and fertiliser recommendations.

resources.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
resources.description: Subsidised crop insurance against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and disease.

resources.name: Kisan Credit Card
resources.description: Low-interest working-capital credit for cultivation and allied activities.

resources.name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
resources.description: Online trading platform linking mandis nationwide for better price discovery.

resources.name: Agmarknet
resources.description: Daily mandi prices for commodities across markets (source of SmartFarm's live prices).

resources.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
resources.description: Support and certification assistance for organic and natural farming clusters.

resources.name: PM-KUSUM
resources.description: Subsidy for solar pumps and grid-connected solar power for irrigation.

resources.name: Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551)
resources.description: Toll-free agricultural advisory in regional languages.

resources.name: AP Rythu Bharosa / YSR schemes
resources.description: Andhra Pradesh state investment support and input assistance for farmers.

resources.name: Telangana Rythu Bandhu
resources.description: Telangana per-acre per-season investment support for agriculture.
